Load Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst into a packed bed reactor or immobilize in coil (Chemistry Plan: Heterogeneous Catalysis).

chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation of N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol using Pd(OH)2/Al2O3. Acetic acid added to enhance rate. Flow design targets 30x intensification (5h batch -> 10min flow) via improved gas-liquid mass transfer. Packed bed reactor preferred for heterogeneous catalyst to avoid clogging and allow continuous operation. BPR required to maintain H2 solubility at 60C.
